name: mpv
author: Maximilian-Maag
description: Integrates the installed mpv media player with Omarchy: reads the live colors.toml and generates an mpv theme fragment (subtitle, OSD and window colours) that your own mpv.conf includes, drives a running mpv (play/pause/next/prev/volume) over its JSON IPC socket, and adds Hyprland media-key bindings.

features: Reads the applied theme live from ~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/colors.toml — no baked-in palette, any theme works
Generates ~/.config/mpv/omarchy-theme.conf (subtitle colour/outline, OSD colour/selection, window background)
Writes to a dedicated file so your existing ~/.config/mpv/mpv.conf is never modified beyond a guarded include= line
send drives a running mpv over its JSON IPC socket: play, pause, toggle, next, prev, stop, mute, volume
theme-set hook regenerates the fragment and applies the colours to a running mpv live over IPC
Hyprland media-key bindings (Super + XF86AudioPlay/Next/Prev/Stop) plus Super+Shift+Alt+M to open mpv
status reports the applied theme, the generated fragment, the IPC socket and the mpv version
